meaning: The moment the data snapshot represents. Every 'today', 'overdue', 'silent', 'days in pasture' and 'closed month' judgement is measured from it.
units_valid: Current value '2026-09-30T18:00' has no UTC offset, so browsers read it as viewer-local time. Phase 1: ISO 8601 with offset (for example 2026-09-30T18:00-05:00), or a bare local time interpreted in meta.timezone.
id_relationship_rules: One row; applies to every other file.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Reject a value that does not parse. Without an offset or meta.timezone, show 'data time unknown', drop 'today' wording and treat time-based rules as CAN'T TELL. Rows dated after as_of are excluded from rules and counted as data issues.
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): MDN localStorage has nothing on timestamps, offsets or time zones. The rationale (JavaScript parses an offset-less date-time as viewer-local time) is an observation; cite MDN Date.parse or ECMA-262 if a source is wanted. Evidence URL removed. Checker (budget): GFOA says nothing about timestamps or time zones. No supporting source after checker review (MDN localStorage and GFOA were rejected for this field). The problem itself was observed in the repository.

meaning: Pasture key (demo P1-P8).
id_relationship_rules: Primary key. Referenced by moves.pasture_id, water.pasture_id and tanks.pasture_id.
timestamp_and_frequency: Static; changes when pastures are re-fenced.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Duplicate or blank id: data issue, and rows that reference it are CAN'T TELL. A moves or water row with an unknown pasture_id is a data issue, not a grazing or water alarm.

meaning: Display name (demo: North Flat, Windmill, ...).
units_valid: Text; shown as text, never as HTML.
id_relationship_rules: Display only; never used as a key.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Show the pasture_id instead.

meaning: Pasture area.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank or non-numeric: shown as unknown; no current rule uses it. Needed later for AU-day planning (RULE-GRZ-07).

meaning: The ranch's planned stay length for one visit to this pasture (demo values 10-21 days).
units_valid: Integer days > 0. A planning value, not a published standard.
timestamp_and_frequency: Set when the grazing plan is written; revised in season.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank or invalid: the open stay is CAN'T TELL (data issue), not 'over plan'.

meaning: Minimum recovery period before the pasture is grazed again (demo 30-60 days). No shipped code reads it today.
units_valid: Integer days > 0. State technical notes give ranges by growth period and use level (for example NDSU R1780 and SD TN9).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Rest check (phase 2) shows 'no rest target set' for that pasture.

meaning: Management group name (demo: Cows, Heifers, Yearlings).
id_relationship_rules: Primary key. Referenced by moves.group, weights.group and health.group.
timestamp_and_frequency: Changes when groups are formed or sold.
validation_and_missing_behavior: A row elsewhere naming an unknown group is a data issue shown on the page, not silently dropped.

meaning: Animal class (demo: cow-calf pairs, first-calf heifers, yearling steers). Drives wording now and intake lookups later.
units_valid: Text; later a controlled list matching the intake table classes.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Shown as 'class not recorded'; class-based lookups are skipped (CAN'T TELL).

meaning: Current head count in the group.
timestamp_and_frequency: On any move, sale, death or purchase.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Coverage cannot be computed, so the group gain verdict is withheld (CAN'T TELL).
evidence_note: Checker (gain): the Data.gov CPER dataset page does not support the groups.head field. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: The ADG the group is judged against (demo: Yearlings 2.0, Heifers 1.0, Cows 0.0 = not judged).
units_valid: lb/day >= 0. 0 means the gain rules skip the group; the page must say so (RULE-GAIN-05). Demo values are demo settings.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank or non-numeric: the group is CAN'T TELL for gain, never silently skipped.

meaning: Group that made the stay.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Unknown group: data issue row.

meaning: Pasture of the stay.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Unknown pasture: data issue (CAN'T TELL), not a grazing alarm.

meaning: Day the group entered the pasture.
units_valid: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, on or before as_of.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank, invalid or after as_of: data issue; the stay is not judged.

meaning: Day the group left; blank means the stay is open.
units_valid: ISO date, on or after in_date; blank = open stay.
id_relationship_rules: At most one open stay per group; two or more is a data issue.
validation_and_missing_behavior: out_date before in_date, or a group with more than one open stay: data issue (CAN'T TELL), not a grazing alarm.

meaning: Tank the reading came from (demo T1-T8).
id_relationship_rules: Must exist in tanks.csv (phase-1 master list). A tank in tanks.csv with no readings is CAN'T TELL, not absent.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Unknown tank_id: data issue.
evidence_note: Checker (water): the NRCS 614 citation has no bearing on this field. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Pasture the tank serves, repeated on each reading.
id_relationship_rules: Must agree with tanks.csv pasture_id for that tank; a mismatch is a data issue. tanks.csv becomes the authority.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Mismatch or unknown: data issue; the tank keeps its tanks.csv pasture.

meaning: Time of the reading.
units_valid: Current values have no UTC offset. Phase 1: ISO 8601 with offset, or local time read in meta.timezone.
id_relationship_rules: Per (tank_id, time); duplicates are a data issue.
timestamp_and_frequency: Per reading (demo every 6 h; vendors 4/day satellite to 24/day cellular).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Unparseable: reading rejected. Readings after as_of are excluded. Silence is measured from as_of.
evidence_note: Checker (water): the Ranchbot Delay page supports irregular reporting and staleness; the time-zone requirement comes from the repo audit, not this page.

meaning: Tank level as percent full.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank, non-numeric or outside 0-100: not a reading (never treated as 0); counted as a data issue.

meaning: Animal identifier.
units_valid: String, unique per animal; never reused.
id_relationship_rules: One animal belongs to one group per weigh-in; the same tag twice on one date is a data issue.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Row rejected and counted in a data-issues line.
evidence_url: https://docs.c-lockinc.com/Document - Beef Improvement Federation Guidelines for FE Testing.pdf
evidence_note: Checker (gain): the BIF guidelines (vendor-hosted copy) support per-animal pairing only indirectly and say nothing about tag uniqueness.

meaning: Group at the weigh-in.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Row excluded from group figures and reported as a data issue.

units_valid: ISO date, on or before as_of.
id_relationship_rules: (group, date) identifies the weigh session (see weigh_sessions.csv).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Row rejected; dates after as_of are excluded.

meaning: Live weight.
units_valid: lb, number > 0; plausible range per class (for example 300-1,000 yearlings); no thousands separators.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank or implausible: excluded and listed as a data issue, never coerced to 0.

meaning: Group the scheduled task applies to.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Show a 'group not recorded' data-issue row.

meaning: Schedule label (demo: Booster vaccine, Pinkeye check, Deworm, ...).
units_valid: Text; a schedule label only, never a finding, diagnosis or treatment instruction. Rendered as text.
id_relationship_rules: (group, task) identifies a schedule row today; a task_id is added later.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank: data issue row.
evidence_note: Checker (health): 21 CFR 530.3 defines the VCPR; it does not address task labels. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Date the task was last completed.
units_valid: ISO date, on or before as_of; blank allowed for a task never done.
id_relationship_rules: Per schedule row. Later, completions go to an append-only history (RULE-WF-16).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank is allowed; an invalid date is a data issue.

meaning: Planned date for the task (demo: Yearlings booster 2026-09-15, Cows pinkeye check 2026-10-03).
units_valid: ISO date. Blank is allowed only on done or cancelled rows.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank on an open task: show a 'No due date recorded' data-issue row (today it is skipped silently).

meaning: Task state.
units_valid: open | done | cancelled | deferred, compared after trimming and lower-casing.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Any other value is a data-issue row (today it is dropped silently).
evidence_note: Checker (health): the BQA manual does not address task status vocabularies. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Budget month (demo 2026-06 to 2026-09).
id_relationship_rules: (month, category) unique; a duplicate pair is a data issue.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Invalid month: row rejected with a data-quality message. Months after meta.books_closed_through count as plan only, not as season-to-date.

meaning: Spending category (demo: Feed and mineral, Fuel, Labor, Repairs, Vet and health, Water and fencing).
units_valid: Controlled list; later mapped to ERS cost items (RULE-BUD-12).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank: row rejected. An unmapped category is still monitored.

meaning: Planned spend for that category and month (the phased plan).
units_valid: USD >= 0; plain digits with optional decimal (no '$', no thousands separators, no '(300)').
timestamp_and_frequency: Set before the season; monthly columns.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank = 'no budget entered' data issue (not 0). An explicit 0 goes to the unbudgeted-spend rule in dollars (RULE-BUD-06).
evidence_note: Checker (budget): UNL CropWatch supports monthly phasing only; the number-format and blank-versus-0 rules are the data contract's, not the source's.

meaning: Actual spend for that category and month.
units_valid: USD, signed number (credits allowed later via entry_type).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Blank in a closed month = 'actual not entered' row; no severity for that category. Never treated as $0.

meaning: The ranch's IANA time zone, used to read local times and to display as_of.
units_valid: IANA name, for example America/Chicago or America/Denver.
id_relationship_rules: One value for the whole snapshot.
validation_and_missing_behavior: If as_of carries an offset, use it and show the offset; otherwise show 'time zone not set' and treat time-based rules as CAN'T TELL.
evidence_note: A data-contract decision (lead phase-1 default); no external source needed.

meaning: Last month whose actuals are complete.
units_valid: YYYY-MM, not after the month of as_of.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Default to the month before as_of's month and label it 'assumed closed through'.
evidence_note: Checker (budget): GFOA 'Budget monitoring' says nothing about books-closed months or data completeness. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Every tank the ranch expects to hear from, so a tank with no readings is visible.
id_relationship_rules: Primary key; water.tank_id must exist here.
validation_and_missing_behavior: If tanks.csv is missing, fall back to tanks seen in water.csv and show 'tank list not provided'.

meaning: Pasture the tank serves.
id_relationship_rules: Foreign key to pastures.csv; one tank per pasture in the demo, several allowed.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Unknown pasture: data issue.

meaning: Display name.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Show tank_id.

meaning: Whether the tank is in use (a tank drained for winter is out of service).
timestamp_and_frequency: Rare; record who changed it later (RULE-WF-19).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Treat as in service. An out-of-service tank is shown as 'out of service' and not judged; it is never hidden.
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): HSE CHIS6 supports suppressing out-of-service plant; the changed_by/at/reason audit fields are the researcher's design.

meaning: How the weights in a session were taken, so ADG compares like with like.
id_relationship_rules: One row per (group, date) in weights.csv.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Basis unknown or different between the two sessions: ADG shown as provisional, with no serious or individual flags (CAN'T TELL). The demo must record a basis for every session so the planted gain problems still show.

meaning: Level below which a tank is critical (demo 25%).
units_valid: Percent 0-100; label 'Demo setting (D)' or 'Ranch choice' in the rules table.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Not configured: show levels without severity and say 'threshold not set'.

meaning: Level below which a tank is a warning (demo 40%).
validation_and_missing_behavior: As waterCritical.

meaning: Fall in points over a bounded window that counts as an unexplained fall (demo 30 points in 24 h).
units_valid: Points 0-100; window in hours with a tolerance of one reporting interval.
validation_and_missing_behavior: As waterCritical.

meaning: Hours without a reading, measured from as_of, before a tank is CAN'T TELL (demo 24 h).
units_valid: Hours > 0; later per device from expected_report_interval_h.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Use 24 h and label it an assumption.

meaning: Days before a planned move date that raise a warning (demo 2).
validation_and_missing_behavior: No move-reminder warning.

meaning: Share of the group target below which group gain is serious (demo 0.8).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Show ADG without verdict.

meaning: Share of the group target below which an individual is listed (demo 0.5).
validation_and_missing_behavior: No individual list.

field: gain minimum interval and minimum coverage (new)
meaning: Shortest weigh interval (or number of weights) before ADG is judged, and the share of the group that must be weighed in both sessions.
units_valid: Days > 0 (research default for individuals about 70 d or 3+ weights); coverage fraction 0-1. Values must be chosen and tested so the demo's planted gain problems are still found.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Gain verdicts shown as provisional (CAN'T TELL).

meaning: Days ahead that an open health task becomes a warning (demo 7).
validation_and_missing_behavior: No due-soon warning.

field: budget thresholds (budgetWarn, budgetSerious, warnUsd, seriousUsd, largeUsd, unbudgetedUsd)
meaning: Percent and dollar materiality for budget rows. Current: budgetWarn 0.05, budgetSerious 0.10. Phase-1 demo values: warn 5% and $500, serious 10% and $1,000, large $2,500, unbudgeted $250.
units_valid: Fractions 0-1 and USD >= 0; inclusive comparisons; every value labelled 'Demo setting'.
timestamp_and_frequency: Once a season or after review.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Show variances with no severity and a 'thresholds not set' note.

meaning: Why each threshold exists: 'Demo setting (D)' until sourced or set by the ranch, then 'Ranch choice, set by <name>, <date>'.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Label the threshold 'Demo setting (unvalidated)'.
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): HSE CHIS6 supports alarm change control and audits; the change-log schema is the researcher's design.

meaning: Usable capacity, and the geometry that converts level to gallons Also: Tank volume and how it refills
units_valid: gal > 0; shape in {vertical cylinder, horizontal cylinder, elliptical, rectangular}; ft
timestamp_and_frequency: once, and on any tank change
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: gal > 0; shape in {vertical cylinder, horizontal cylinder, elliptical, rectangular}; ft. Missing or invalid: Do not compute hours. Show 'capacity unknown'. Severity falls back to the labelled demo % rule.

meaning: Float-fed drinking tank vs storage tank vs hauled-water tank vs pond/dugout
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum {float_fed, storage, hauled, surface}. Missing or invalid: Do not apply leak or drawdown logic. Show the fall without interpretation.

meaning: Water source (electric well, solar, windmill, pipeline, rural water, hauled) and measured inflow Also: Tank volume and how it refills
timestamp_and_frequency: once a season or after repair (Bartlett: test well yield and drawdown with a driller, because summer use rises)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum; gpm ≥0. Missing or invalid: Hours-of-water shown with zero inflow only, labelled worst case

meaning: Distance between the sensor and the usable bottom (mud, outlet height)
units_valid: inches, ±240 per Ranchbot (vendor) input validation; datetime
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches, ±240 per Ranchbot (vendor) input validation; datetime. Missing or invalid: Flag readings as 'offset unknown' near thresholds

meaning: How often this device should report
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: hours > 0. Missing or invalid: Use the fixed 24 h silence limit, labelled an assumption

field: out_of_service audit (changed_by, changed_at, reason), tank_shutoff, planned_move_in
meaning: Asset deliberately excluded from rules, e.g. a tank drained for winter Also: A float deliberately off in a resting pasture, and the next use
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: boolean plus audit fields. Missing or invalid: Treat as in service
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): HSE CHIS6 supports suppressing out-of-service plant; the changed_by/at/reason audit fields are the researcher's design.

meaning: Alternative source and gallons per haul
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: text; gal. Missing or invalid: Action text cannot name a backup

meaning: Measured water height above the sensor, before offset
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches, ≥0. Missing or invalid: Use level_pct and mark it uncalibrated

meaning: Vendor status (OK, Delay, No Data, Error, Error High, Error Low)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum per vendor. Missing or invalid: Infer only 'silent' from the timestamps

meaning: Monitor battery voltage
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: V (vendor: 6.6-7.2 healthy, <6.5 likely failing). Missing or invalid: Cause of silence reported as unknown
evidence_note: Voltage bands are vendor statements (Farmbot), model-specific.

meaning: Metered inflow per day
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: gal/day ≥0. Missing or invalid: No overflow or stuck-open detection; say so
evidence_note: Checker (water): NRCS Missouri 'Watering Systems for Serious Graziers' never mentions flow or water meters. Evidence URL removed.

field: checked_at, checked_by, result (ok / low / dirty / float-fault / leak / dry), float_ok, overflow, ice, notes
meaning: In-person observation Also: Eyes-on confirmation of tank function and cleanliness
id_relationship_rules: Keyed by tank_id and time; tank_id must exist in tanks.csv.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: datetime; booleans; free text. Missing or invalid: Show 'not checked by eye since <date>'
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): 'daily' appears only in a BQA sample protocol template; the assessment itself does not require daily checks. Checker (water): the NDSU 2007 release supports only more frequent checks in heat, not the log's structure.

field: source_id, date, method (meter/strip/lab), tds_ppm, sulfate_ppm, nitrate_ppm (state NO3 or NO3-N)
meaning: Screening and lab results
id_relationship_rules: source_id = tank_id or a named pond/well.
timestamp_and_frequency: per test (in drought, for new or surface sources)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ppm (mg/L); method enum. Missing or invalid: Show 'not screened'; never 'OK'

field: algae observation (source_id, date, status none/suspect/bloom, photo, sample_sent, vet_contacted)
meaning: Cyanobacteria watch on surface water
id_relationship_rules: source_id = tank_id or a named pond.
timestamp_and_frequency: weekly or more in late summer heat (ranch choice)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum; booleans. Missing or invalid: Show 'not observed'

meaning: Time to reach the tank, and the next scheduled pass
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: hours; datetime. Missing or invalid: Use a ranch default and label it

field: head present by class per pasture
meaning: Animals drinking at this tank now
units_valid: integer head; class in {cow-calf pairs, first-calf heifers, yearling steers, ...}
id_relationship_rules: Open stays in moves.csv joined to groups.csv; a pasture with an unknown group is CAN'T TELL.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer head; class in {cow-calf pairs, first-calf heifers, yearling steers, ...}. Missing or invalid: Treat the tank as possibly in use. Do not downgrade severity.

field: water status of the occupied and destination pasture
meaning: Latest tank level and sensor freshness, already computed by waterStatus()
id_relationship_rules: tanks.pasture_id joined to the group's open stay and planned_next_pasture.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: % full; hours since last reading. Missing or invalid: Silent sensor gives 'water unknown: check by eye before moving'

meaning: Inputs to intake lookup Also: Calving date and whether the animal is nursing
id_relationship_rules: Per group (or per animal for calving dates).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: lb; enum {dry, lactating, growing}. Missing or invalid: Use the class default and label the assumption

meaning: Reference daily intake by class, weight and temperature Also: Estimated daily intake by class, weight and temperature
id_relationship_rules: Rows by class; columns by temperature band (40-90F).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: gal/head/day; table rows 40-90F. Missing or invalid: Use the highest value in the class's row and label it an assumed hot-day figure (for lactating cows in AS1763 that is 80F, 17.9 gal)
evidence_note: Checker: the 90F column is not the most conservative for lactating cows (AS1763: 17.9 gal at 80F vs 16.2 at 90F).

field: daily_high_f and hourly forecast (temp_f, rh_pct, wind_mph, sky_cover_pct), forecast THI
meaning: NWS gridpoint hourly forecast for the location Also: Temperature driving intake / Temperature-humidity index computed from hourly forecast temperature and RH or dewpoint for the ranch location
id_relationship_rules: Keyed by forecast point and hour; pinned to as_of in the demo.
timestamp_and_frequency: Not stated on the cited documentation page; record retrieved_at on each snapshot
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: F, %, mph, %. Missing or invalid: No heat/cold panel; never default to 'Normal'
evidence_note: Checker (health): weather.gov documentation states no forecast update frequency; 'several times daily' is unsupported.

meaning: ARS breathing-rate category from the forecast
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Normal <90, Alert 90-110, Danger 110-130, Emergency >130 breaths/min. Missing or invalid: Hide

meaning: Comprehensive Climate Index apparent temperature
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: degrees F; NDAWN bands. Missing or invalid: Hide

meaning: Planned move-out date for this stay (replaces the per-pasture planned_graze_days as the plan of record)
units_valid: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, on or after in_date
timestamp_and_frequency: When the plan is written or revised
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, on or after in_date. Missing or invalid: Fall back to in_date + pasture planned_graze_days and label it 'default plan'

meaning: Destination pasture for the next move
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: pasture_id in pastures.csv. Missing or invalid: Show 'destination not planned'; skip the destination readiness check (do not report ready)
evidence_note: Checker (grazing): CPS 528 supports only the general water and monitoring criteria; its link to this field is loose.

meaning: Head count and average weight (or AUE) of the group on this stay
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer head > 0; lb (or AUE 0.5-1.5). Missing or invalid: Use groups.csv head and a class-default AUE labelled as an assumption

meaning: Recorded reason for an intentional deviation (early re-entry, combined herds, dormant-season use, targeted grazing, drought)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: free text or enumerated code. Missing or invalid: The deviation is reported as a warning

meaning: Recovery minimum before re-grazing during fast (vegetative, pre-boot) and slow (boot onward) growth
units_valid: integer days, roughly 25-90; defaults from the state NRCS FOTG (e.g. SD TN9 West River range 40/60 at 20-30% use; NDSU western ND range 45/65)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer days, roughly 25-90; defaults from the state NRCS FOTG (e.g. SD TN9 West River range 40/60 at 20-30% use; NDSU western ND range 45/65). Missing or invalid: Use the existing single min_rest_days and label it 'not growth-adjusted'

meaning: Window in which rest counts as recovery
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: month-day. Missing or invalid: Count all calendar days and label the rest figure 'calendar days'

meaning: Species monitored in the pasture's key area and its minimum residual height at end of grazing
units_valid: species name; inches (e.g. western wheatgrass 4, big bluestem 6, Kentucky bluegrass 2 per SD TN9 Table 3)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: species name; inches (e.g. western wheatgrass 4, big bluestem 6, Kentucky bluegrass 2 per SD TN9 Table 3). Missing or invalid: Stubble rule disabled for the pasture; show 'no target set'

meaning: Forage available for planning graze days
units_valid: lb/ac air-dry; harvest efficiency 0.125-0.40 (NDSU: 25% season-long native, 30% tame)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: lb/ac air-dry; harvest efficiency 0.125-0.40 (NDSU: 25% season-long native, 30% tame). Missing or invalid: Label planned days 'manager plan, not forage-derived'

field: date, pasture_id, observer, residual_in or utilization_pct, recovery_ready, photo_point
meaning: Field check of residual and regrowth
id_relationship_rules: pasture_id must exist in pastures.csv; link to the stay by pasture and date.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches or %; yes/no/unsure; text. Missing or invalid: 'Recovery not checked' before planned move-in

meaning: Mean grazed height of the key species in the key area
units_valid: inches >= 0; n_readings integer (NDSU suggests at least 30 per key species)
timestamp_and_frequency: Before entry, about weekly during occupancy, within 3 days of exit
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches >= 0; n_readings integer (NDSU suggests at least 30 per key species). Missing or invalid: Stale-observation warning; never 'OK'

meaning: Percent of current-year growth removed by weight
id_relationship_rules: Per pasture_id and stay or season.
timestamp_and_frequency: End of each stay (temporal); end of season (seasonal)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: 0-100; method in {grazing-stick height-weight, ocular, paired-plot}. Missing or invalid: Do not report compliance with take-half-leave-half

meaning: Phenology of the key species (vegetative/pre-boot = fast; boot, heading, seed = slow; dormant)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum. Missing or invalid: Use a month proxy (May/Jun fast, Jul/Aug slow) labelled as an assumption

meaning: Quick ranch-defined condition/readiness score for the pasture. NRCS's 10-indicator 1-5 Pasture Condition Score is framed around improved (tame) pastures; that it does not apply to rangeland is an inference, not stated in the guide.
units_valid: ordinal 1-5 (ranch rubric) or NRCS PCS total for tame pasture
timestamp_and_frequency: Before grazing (NRCS PCS: best just before a pasture is grazed) and at critical periods
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ordinal 1-5 (ranch rubric) or NRCS PCS total for tame pasture. Missing or invalid: Not shown

meaning: Herd behaviour that signals forage shortfall (walking fence, bunching at gate/water, selecting less-preferred plants)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum + free text. Missing or invalid: Treat as unknown, not normal
evidence_url: https://www.ars.usda.gov/ARSUserFiles/51815/67. 2020 REM - CARM - adaptive multipaddock rotational grazing - vegetation and livestock responses.pdf

meaning: RAP annual herbaceous production, weighted mean over the pasture polygon Also: Modelled herbaceous production per pasture polygon (annual; 16-day provisional for current year)
units_valid: lbs/acre; years 1986 to the previous year
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: lbs/acre; years 1986 to the previous year. Missing or invalid: No polygon: omit; no county substitute

meaning: NRCS ecological site and its reference production
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ESD ID string; lbs/acre (normal/favorable/unfavorable). Missing or invalid: Label planned_graze_days as ranch-set

meaning: Real county/state used as a labelled stand-in for public context (the ranch is fictional)
id_relationship_rules: One value; the demo uses a labelled stand-in county.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: 5-digit FIPS (e.g. 46065); state postal code. Missing or invalid: Hide all public-context panels

meaning: Percent of county area in each USDM category Also: U.S. Drought Monitor category D0-D4 for the ranch county / U.S. Drought Monitor category for the county
id_relationship_rules: Keyed by county FIPS and valid date.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: 0-100 %. Missing or invalid: Show 'Drought Monitor unavailable, last valid <date>'; never 'no drought'
evidence_note: Checker (context, grazing, gain): the Web Service Info page does not mention thousands separators and states no release schedule; the Tuesday-valid, Thursday-released timing is on the USDM home page.

meaning: MapDate (Tuesday valid date) and the release instant (Thursday 08:30 ET)
id_relationship_rules: Per USDM week; select the latest released at or before as_of.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: YYYY-MM-DD; ISO instant. Missing or invalid: Do not show the category without both dates
evidence_note: Checker (context): drought.gov says only 'Thursday morning'; the 08:30 ET release time is on the USDM home page (re-read by the citation critic 2026-10-16).

meaning: Count of the last 8 weekly maps with any (or at least X%) county area in D2+
units_valid: 0-8 weeks; X% is a ranch choice
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: 0-8 weeks; X% is a ranch choice. Missing or invalid: Show 'incomplete series' if any week is missing

meaning: Where each context value came from and when
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: URL; ISO instant; text. Missing or invalid: Do not display a value without provenance
evidence_note: Checker (context): the Permission page's 'Map courtesy of NDMC' wording is map guidance; applying it to data rows is an extension.

meaning: Ranch-measured daily precipitation Also: Precipitation since a reference date vs normal
units_valid: inches >= 0; one row per day; blank is not zero
id_relationship_rules: One row per gauge per day; blank is not zero.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches >= 0; one row per day; blank is not zero. Missing or invalid: Gaps block % of normal; show 'gauge record incomplete'

meaning: Public gridded or station precipitation and its normal for the location
units_valid: inches; retrieval timestamp (values revised for ~6 months)
id_relationship_rules: Per grid cell or station and date.
timestamp_and_frequency: daily, revised up to 8 times over 6 months (PRISM)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: inches; retrieval timestamp (values revised for ~6 months). Missing or invalid: Show the gauge only

meaning: Ranch-defined critical dates and actions
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: date; text; number; text. Missing or invalid: No trigger prompts

meaning: State pasture and range condition, % very poor+poor and % good+excellent
timestamp_and_frequency: weekly in season (the 4:00 pm ET release time comes from a 2007 NASS document and was not confirmed by a current source)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: 0-100 %; week-ending Sunday date. Missing or invalid: Off-season or missing: 'no report for week ending X'

meaning: Forecast % change in grassland production vs the cell's ~38-year average under a precipitation scenario Also: Forecast % change in total grassland production vs the grid cell's long-term average / Grass-Cast forecast of rangeland production vs the long-term average for the ranch's grid cell, by precipitation scenario
id_relationship_rules: Per 10 km cell and map date.
timestamp_and_frequency: every two weeks, late April to Aug 31
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: percent; date; above/near/below-normal. Missing or invalid: Out of season: show the final value with 'season closed' or hide

meaning: Electronic ID (RFID) read at the scale, used to match weights to animals
units_valid: RFID string; confirm length and format against the reader's export (the 15-digit format is unsourced in this audit)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: RFID string in the format the reader exports. Missing or invalid: Fall back to tag
evidence_note: Checker (gain): the Tru-Test info sheet does not mention a 15-digit RFID format or any reduction in tag-entry errors. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Clock time the animal (or session) was weighed
units_valid: HH:MM local, with a stated timezone
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: HH:MM local, with a stated timezone. Missing or invalid: ADG marked 'conditions unknown'

meaning: Shrink deducted, if a pencil shrink is applied
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: 0-10 %. Missing or invalid: Treated as 0 and stated

meaning: When cattle were gathered and how long they stood off feed and water before weighing
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: HH:MM; hours 0-24. Missing or invalid: 'conditions unknown' note

meaning: Which scale was used and the result of the zero/known-weight check
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: string; lb; lb; yes/no. Missing or invalid: Informational 'scale not checked' note

meaning: How the class is judged
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ADG | BCS | none. Missing or invalid: Default by class: yearlings ADG; cows and first-calf heifers BCS

field: group, forage type, start_date, end_date, expected_adg_lbs, supplemented
meaning: Expected ADG for a period of the season Also: Whether the group is receiving supplement in the period
timestamp_and_frequency: per season, revised with forage outlook
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: lb/d, typically -0.5 to 3.0; dates ISO. Missing or invalid: Report ADG without verdict, or compare to ranch prior years

field: group or tag, date, score, target
meaning: Body condition score of a cow or first-calf heifer (or a group median from a sample) Also: Ranch target BCS at a scoring point / Body condition score
id_relationship_rules: tag must exist in the animal list, or group in groups.csv.
timestamp_and_frequency: weaning, ~45 d after weaning, ~90 d before calving, calving, breeding start, late summer in drought
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: 1-9, half points allowed. Missing or invalid: 'Condition not recorded' shown; no 'all clear'

meaning: Inputs for the replacement-heifer target-weight projection
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: lb; 50-70 %; ISO date. Missing or invalid: No projection

field: date, group, tag(s), observer, head_with_signs, sign_code, note, escalated
meaning: What was seen on a pasture check, recorded as signs, not diagnoses Also: What was seen when a slow animal was checked
units_valid: sign_code from a fixed list (watery_eyes, squinting, cloudy_eye, lame, off_feed, found_dead, abortion, other); head_with_signs integer >= 0
id_relationship_rules: group in groups.csv; tags in weights.csv. Observations only; no diagnosis.
timestamp_and_frequency: every pasture check; at least the ranch-set interval in fly season
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: sign_code from a fixed list (watery_eyes, squinting, cloudy_eye, lame, off_feed, found_dead, abortion, other); head_with_signs integer >= 0. Missing or invalid: 'No check recorded since [date]'. Never 'group clear'.

meaning: Stable ID of a scheduled health task, so completions can link to it
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: string, unique. Missing or invalid: Reject the row with a visible data-issue message. Do not drop it silently.
evidence_note: Checker (health): the BQA manual does not address task IDs. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Individual IDs when the task or record is for specific animals (official 840 EID where applicable)
units_valid: list of IDs; official ID format per APHIS for covered cattle
id_relationship_rules: Official IDs where APHIS rules apply.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: list of IDs; official ID format per APHIS for covered cattle. Missing or invalid: Treat the record as a group record

meaning: Kind of job; sets lead time, severity and wording
units_valid: vaccination | parasite_control | fly_control | observation | vet_exam (pregnancy check, BSE) | other
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: vaccination | parasite_control | fly_control | observation | vet_exam (pregnancy check, BSE) | other. Missing or invalid: Use neutral wording ('Past planned date') and no vaccination or observation wording

meaning: Who set the timing
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: product_label | vet_plan | ranch_plan. Missing or invalid: Show 'window source not recorded: check label or vet plan'. No confident overdue wording.

meaning: Earliest acceptable date (from label, vet plan, or derived from breeding dates) Also: Latest acceptable date. Replaces the single next_due as the overdue test.
units_valid: YYYY-MM-DD (date-only, as health dates already are; HB-C8 observed these are zone-safe)
id_relationship_rules: Per task; window_end on or after window_start.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: YYYY-MM-DD (date-only, as health dates already are; HB-C8 observed these are zone-safe). Missing or invalid: Warn from window_end minus lead time

meaning: Person or role who owns the task (crew lead, herd vet) Also: Task needs the veterinarian present or booked (preg check, BSE, prescription product)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: text. Missing or invalid: Show 'Unassigned' in the row
evidence_note: Checker (health): the KS-BQA form's 'Crew Initials' records who did the work, not who owns an upcoming task.

meaning: Date the task was completed (completion record, append-only) Also: Person administering or performing the task
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: YYYY-MM-DD, not after as_of. Missing or invalid: 'done' without done_date shows as 'record incomplete'

meaning: Number of head actually worked or treated Also: Group head count at the time of the task
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer 0..group head. Missing or invalid: 'head count not recorded'. Do not claim full coverage.
evidence_note: Checker (health): the KS-BQA form's 'No. of Head' supports head_done (head processed), not head_planned.

meaning: Product name and manufacturer lot/serial number (record only, never shown as an instruction) Also: Route and injection site (record only)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: text. Missing or invalid: 'record incomplete'
evidence_note: Record only. Never shown as an instruction; may stay in the ranch's health record system (RULE-WF-16).

meaning: Earliest date the animals clear withdrawal (from label, or from the veterinarian for extralabel use)
id_relationship_rules: Per completion; from the label or the veterinarian, never computed by the dashboard.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: YYYY-MM-DD. Missing or invalid: Block any 'clear to ship' reading; show 'withdrawal not recorded'

meaning: Planned sale, shipping or cull date per group
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: YYYY-MM-DD. Missing or invalid: Skip the conflict check and say so

meaning: Ranch-entered dates bounding face- and horn-fly season for observation cadence and fly-tag in and out tasks
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: YYYY-MM-DD. Missing or invalid: Do not run the fly-season observation rule; show a note

meaning: Scouted fly count per animal (record the species; the NDSU 200-per-animal threshold names none)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer >= 0. Missing or invalid: Ignore
evidence_note: Checker (health): the NDSU 2024 article gives 200 flies per animal as the economic threshold but names no species.

meaning: Breeding season exposure dates Also: Breeding-season dates per group
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: dates. Missing or invalid: Cannot compute earliest preg-check date

meaning: Pregnancy diagnosis results for exposed females
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: date; palpation|ultrasound|blood; counts. Missing or invalid: Task stays open

field: death_date, group, id, cause_known, abortion flag; baseline_loss_rate
meaning: Deaths and pregnancy losses, plus the herd's own historical rate
units_valid: dates, IDs; baseline as % per season
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: dates, IDs; baseline as % per season. Missing or invalid: Show counts only and 'set a baseline with your veterinarian'

meaning: Herd veterinarian contact and last recorded premises visit
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: text; YYYY-MM-DD. Missing or invalid: Escalation reads 'Call your veterinarian (no contact recorded)'
evidence_note: Checker (health): 21 CFR 530.3 does not address vet contact fields; its VCPR definition ('medically appropriate and timely visits to the premises') bears only on last_vet_premises_visit.

meaning: Planned gather or processing time for a task day
units_valid: local datetime with a stated time zone (meta.csv as_of has no zone today)
id_relationship_rules: Per handling task; local time with zone.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: local datetime with a stated time zone (meta.csv as_of has no zone today). Missing or invalid: Skip the heat check

meaning: Revised plan for a remaining month after a reforecast
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: USD >= 0. Missing or invalid: Compare against original budget only

meaning: Kind of entry: expense, refund, credit, rebate, tax_credit, prepaid, capital
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum. Missing or invalid: Treated as expense; credits cannot be shown separately
evidence_note: Checker (budget): Penn State supports only the prepaid and payable kinds; refund, credit, rebate, tax_credit and capital are design choices.

meaning: Whether actuals are cash basis or accrual-adjusted
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: enum: cash | accrual_adjusted. Missing or invalid: Label 'basis not stated' beside the spend tile

meaning: Sum of all categories' phased budget to date, used to scale dollar floors
id_relationship_rules: Sum of budget.csv for the season.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: USD. Missing or invalid: Use fixed-dollar floors
evidence_note: Checker (budget): U Alberta's 5% is a share of a unit's own revised budget for year-end carry-forward; nothing scales dollar floors as a share of an organization-wide total. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Gallons delivered or purchased in the month by fuel type Also: Average price paid per gallon from invoices
units_valid: gal >= 0; fuel_type enum dyed_diesel | diesel | gasoline
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: gal >= 0; fuel_type enum dyed_diesel | diesel | gasoline. Missing or invalid: No price/volume split; say 'price vs use unknown'
evidence_note: Checker (budget): MSU P3543 supports modelling fuel as quantity x price for machinery costing only; it says nothing about delivery tickets or variance analysis.

meaning: The quantity and price assumptions behind the fuel budget
timestamp_and_frequency: set at budget time; updated on reforecast
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: gal; USD/gal. Missing or invalid: No price/volume split
evidence_note: Checker (budget): the UNL 2026 cow-herd budget gives fuel only in dollars, with no gallons or price per gallon. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Public on-highway retail diesel price incl. all taxes, used as a market index
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: USD/gal; weekly (Monday) and monthly. Missing or invalid: Hide the context line; never block budget alerts

field: date, asset_id, amount_usd, planned flag, hours_or_miles
meaning: Individual repair events for lumpy-cost attribution
units_valid: ISO date; text id; USD; boolean; hours or miles >= 0
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ISO date; text id; USD; boolean; hours or miles >= 0. Missing or invalid: Repairs alert shows monthly total only, with no 'one breakdown' attribution

meaning: Manager's explanation and who is responsible for a serious variance
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: free text; name or role. Missing or invalid: Alert stays open with 'no explanation recorded'

meaning: Head on hand for per-head context (cost per head vs extension benchmarks)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: integer >= 0. Missing or invalid: No per-head view

meaning: Full-year budget, so season-to-date can be read against the annual plan (extension budgets are annual)
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: USD >= 0. Missing or invalid: Show season-to-date only

field: item, unit, on_hand, count_date, daily_use, lead_time_days
meaning: Feed, supplement and mineral stock
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: tons/bales/lbs/bags; numbers >= 0; date. Missing or invalid: Quantity only, no days on hand

field: asset_id, asset_type, task, last_done, interval_days, next_due, status, assignee
meaning: Fence, water and equipment upkeep log
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: text; dates; integer days; open|done. Missing or invalid: No overdue judgement without next_due/interval

field: task_id, area, subject, assignee, due_date, status, source_exception
meaning: Who is doing what, linked to the exception that created it
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: text; date; open|in-progress|done. Missing or invalid: Unassigned tasks listed as 'unassigned'
evidence_note: Checker (context): the NDMC 'Plan for Drought' page does not support a crew_task field. Evidence URL removed.

field: source_last_update per source (water, weigh-ins, moves, health, budget)
meaning: When each input was last updated, so a fresh as_of cannot hide an old source
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ISO 8601 timestamp per source. Missing or invalid: Show 'unknown' for that source and do not mark its rows 'new'
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): the exida paper has nothing on data freshness; its 'stale alarms' means standing alarms. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Stable key for an exception across loads (area + subject id + rule id, e.g. Water|T4|drop24h)
id_relationship_rules: Deterministic: area + subject id + rule id (for example Water|T4|drop24h).
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: String; deterministic. Missing or invalid: Without it, acknowledgements cannot be matched, so show every row as New and unacknowledged and never hide it
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): the Ignition manual gives no deterministic ID scheme; exception_id is a design assumption. Evidence URL removed.

field: local acknowledgement (exception_id, acked_at), selected filter, last_review_at
meaning: Per-device conveniences for the phase-2 morning review and the optional 'this device only' acknowledgement. Never shared, never clears or hides a condition.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Storage blocked, empty or cleared: every row shows as unacknowledged and the page renders fully. Every call wrapped in try/catch.

meaning: First load or run at which this exception_id was active (current event)
timestamp_and_frequency: Set once per event; a new event after clearing gets a new value
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ISO 8601. Missing or invalid: Show 'age unknown' (not 'new')
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): HSE CHIS6 supports reducing standing alarms; the first_seen_at field design is the researcher's.

meaning: When the data first showed the condition back to normal
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ISO 8601. Missing or invalid: If unknown, a row that disappears is listed as 'no longer flagged (time unknown)' in the Resolved strip
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): Ignition supports separate event states and new events on recurrence, not the cleared_at field design itself.

meaning: Who acknowledged the current event, and when
units_valid: Person name or initials from the crew roster; ISO 8601
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Person name or initials from the crew roster; ISO 8601. Missing or invalid: Row shown as unacknowledged. A missing ack_by is stored as 'unattributed'.
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): the Ignition manual never mentions recording the acknowledging user or time; a design assumption. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Free-text note: what was decided (e.g. 'hauling water 2 pm; float part ordered')
units_valid: Text up to ~280 chars; no treatment details
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Text up to ~280 chars; no treatment details. Missing or invalid: Empty is allowed
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): the BQA Field Guide supports record keeping only; the ~280-character limit and 'no treatment details' are design choices.

meaning: Who will do the first step, and by when
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Crew roster name; date. Missing or invalid: Show 'unassigned', and list it in the briefing under 'unassigned'
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): Cornell's 'Onboarding Farm Employees' page says nothing about task owners or due dates. Evidence URL removed.

meaning: Time-limited hide of a known item, with justification
units_valid: ISO 8601 (bounded max per severity); text; name
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: ISO 8601 (bounded max per severity); text; name. Missing or invalid: Reject the shelve if the expiry or reason is missing. Critical rows cannot be shelved.

field: rule_change_log (rule_id, old, new, changed_by, changed_at, reason)
meaning: Why each threshold and severity exists, and its history
units_valid: Text and enum A/B/C/D; audit rows
id_relationship_rules: Per change; until then the repository history is the record.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Text and enum A/B/C/D; audit rows. Missing or invalid: Label the threshold 'Demo setting (unvalidated)'
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): HSE CHIS6 supports alarm change control and audits; the change-log schema is the researcher's design.

meaning: Consequence of no response and the time available, which justify the severity level
units_valid: Enum (animal welfare / production / financial) plus hours or days
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Enum (animal welfare / production / financial) plus hours or days. Missing or invalid: Show the rule at Warning with 'basis not documented'

meaning: Who can be assigned, and how their briefing is printed
id_relationship_rules: Per person; route pastures must exist in pastures.csv.
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Text; language code (e.g. en, es). Missing or invalid: Print a single unassigned briefing in English
evidence_note: Checker (workflow): Stup (Penn State) has no translation advice; translation comes from Skellie (Cornell 2019).

meaning: How long acknowledgement, notes and visual-check logs are kept
units_valid: Integer, at least 2 (BQA recommendation), longer if law requires
validation_and_missing_behavior: Valid: Integer, at least 2 (BQA recommendation), longer if law requires. Missing or invalid: Default to 2 years; never auto-delete without export
